messages:
anya: quick heads-up — during the HF->Redwood conversion for model-x I saw tokenizer.json with an empty special_tokens_map but tokenizer_config.json defines BOS/EOS. decode failures in the chat evals.

sam: ugh, that explains the weird prefixing in the quantized runs. which files are present in the artifact?

anya: repo has: tokenizer_config.json (with specials), vocab.json, merges.txt, but no tokenizer.json produced by the fast tokenizers lib. there is an added_tokens.json in a different branch though.

miguel: so fast tokenizer path expects tokenizer.json, slow path reads tokenizer_config.json, we ended up picking fast with missing specials which shifted ids. that will break any prompt templates that rely on <s> / </s>.

eva: saw a ~8% hit on our chat-level BLEU/rouge during the quant experiments, likely due to missing eos insertion.

anya: minimal repro: converted artifact -> runtime decode shows trailing tokens appended instead of EOS. example snippets: 
```json
// tokenizer.json (what converter wrote)
{"model_max_length":1024, "special_tokens_map": {}}

// tokenizer_config.json (source)
{"model_max_length":1024, "special_tokens_map": {"bos_token":"<s>", "eos_token":"</s>", "unk_token":"<unk>"}}
```

sam: converter should prefer tokenizer_config.json when tokenizer.json is absent or inconsistent. also copy added_tokens.json if present. can we make the converter detect token id shifts? a checksum on vocab mapping maybe.

miguel: agree. quick mitigation: change runtime to fall back: if special_tokens_map empty, load tokenizer_config.json and rehydrate special token ids by looking up token strings in vocab. fallback order: tokenizer.json -> tokenizer_config.json -> slow tokenizer.

eva: will that cause any perf hit? we want to avoid switching to slow tokenizer at inference time for hosted models. fallback rehydration should be cheap.

anya: opened a PR draft with these changes and a unit test that simulates missing tokenizer.json and verifies EOS insertion in streaming responses: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-conversions/pull/2391

miguel: nice. can we also add a small failing eval to our conversion CI so we catch regressions? add a tiny chat eval that checks presence of eos token and a token-count parity check pre/post conversion.

anya: yes, I'll add the eval and a conversion flag `--prefer-tokenizer-config` and a doc note. planning to ship the PR today, request review from @sam and @miguel.

deploy-bot: CI pipeline started for PR 2391. logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/2391 (tail -f). :gear:

sam: +1, once CI is green let's merge and run the quant pack experiments again (re-run the 4-bit runs). reassigning the conversion ticket to miguel for follow-up on runtime fallback.

miguel: taking it. I'll also add a small script to compare token id mappings across artifacts: `scripts/diff_token_maps.py --old out/ --new out2/` and a short README on the expected ordering of token files.

eva: thanks team — this was causing noisy evaluation diffs. cc @docs for a small note in onboarding checklist about ensuring tokenizer.json contains specials or provide tokenizer_config.json and added_tokens.json together. :white_check_mark:
